references.text: Shelumiel, son of Zurishaddai, is first mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Simeon at the census.
The tribe of Simeon and their leader Shelumiel are mentioned in connection with the camp arrangement around the tabernacle.
Shelumiel, son of Zurishaddai, brought his offering as leader of the tribe of Simeon at the dedication of the altar.
Simeon was Jacob's second son by Leah and the ancestor of the tribe of Simeon.
The sons of Simeon are mentioned among those who went down to Egypt with Jacob.
